claims.statement: EU battery rules address the full lifecycle from sourcing through collection, recycling and repurposing.
Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 establishes electronic battery-passport requirements for specified battery categories.

economics.acquisition_route: Pilot with one Polish commercial fleet and two stationary-storage buyers
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated: 100000 monitored batteries plus 5000 annual transfers could support 7m PLN recurring and transaction revenue, enabling over 5m PLN founder equity in years 6-9
economics.founder_time: 3-5 hours/day; physical diagnostics performed by partners
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated: 70-85% after data normalization and transaction support
economics.pricing: Unvalidated: 100-300 PLN per battery/year plus 3-6% of resale value
economics.retention_or_repeat: Portfolio monitoring recurs annually; transfers recur with retirement cycles

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Observed degradation, bid and realized-resale data improve valuation and attract both sides
fingerprint.customer: EV fleets, industrial battery owners, refurbishers and stationary-storage integrators
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Fleet-management platforms, leasing companies and battery-service partners
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Consent-based passport data room, normalized state-of-health model, forward purchase options and controlled bidding
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Winning buyer pays a success fee when an option or transfer contract is signed; owners can pay for portfolio analytics
fingerprint.problem_trigger: An owner plans battery retirement but lacks trusted buyers able to assess residual value

founder_fit: Strong fit with data science and renewable storage

structure.control_point: permissioned longitudinal battery record and residual-value benchmark
structure.critical_dependency: Owners must have lawful access to sufficiently interoperable battery data and transferable packs

thesis: Let fleet and storage operators grant qualified refurbishers time-limited access to battery records and bid for future second-life purchase rights before packs are retired.
title: Battery Passport Second-Life Rights Exchange
uncertainties: Data access, supply timing and willingness to pay are unvalidated
Polish second-life transaction volume is unknown
